E10_manifest_carries_no_condition_identi.note: the interactive path emits no condition_id, EvidenceActor or ReplicateAuthorisation, so two HC-V0.5 runs cannot be pooled, deduplicated or refused as duplicate draws by arena/evolution/record.py's machinery

E1_selection_provenance_silently_dropped.note: TaskSelection exposes manifest(), never to_dict(); the getattr default swallows the seed, scan_limit, train_json, per-task ids, discard ledger and leakage ledger

E2_step_state_id_is_always_unknown.note: run_episode reads projection.rendered['backend_state_id']; BackendNativeRenderer emits 'state_id'.  Every recorded action is therefore unbound to a state

E3_task_id_in_the_artefact_is_the_proble.note: EpisodeResult(task_id=task.problem_id, ...); the vtask- identity that covers the budget, failure policy, seal and source hash appears nowhere in the artefact

E4_solver_digest_asserted_not_verified.note: run_episode() and episode.main() never call OllamaTacticSolver.verify_served(); the digest in the manifest is a module constant

E5_transport_failure_counted_as_a_solver.note: EpisodeResult.parse_failures counts every proposal_status != OK, so TRANSPORT_FAILURE and PROMPT_OVER_BUDGET are charged to the Solver; summarise()'s environment_errors counts neither

E6_crashed_episode_reported_as_open.note: terminal_status is initialised to the truthy string "OPEN", so the `or` fallback can never fire

E7_solver_parse_failure_bypasses_the_fai.note: the runner `break`s on a non-OK proposal without stepping the task, so ONE_DIAGNOSTIC_RETRY never applies to the single most likely solver-attributable failure, and the episode is filed OPEN rather than FAILED

E8_actor_label_is_a_literal.note: nothing in the artefact binds an action to the Solver that produced it beyond the per-step prompt_sha256
